title: Field-ridge structured bioactive Zn-based scaffold promotes bone regeneration via cellular mechanotransduction.
first_author_affiliation: Emergent Dental Care and General Dentistry, Beijing Stomatological Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing, 100070, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Luyuan Jin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Emergent Dental Care and General Dentistry, Beijing Stomatological Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing, 100070, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接涉及LPBF制备的锌基多孔支架，通过表面纹理调控机械转导促进骨再生，与AM生物医学材料方向高度相关。
why_not_core: 该论文未涉及应力遮挡或刚度匹配的定量分析，也未进行疲劳测试，主要聚焦于骨再生和机械转导机制。

summary_zh.motivation: 大段骨缺损缺乏成骨微环境，需开发仿生支架促进骨再生。
summary_zh.method: 通过LPBF激光扫描策略制备具有沟脊纹理的Zn-0.4Li多孔支架，调控熔道重叠形成表面纹理。
summary_zh.result: 支架促进BMSCs粘附、机械转导信号激活及成骨分化，加速兔颅骨缺损修复。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和兔临界尺寸颅骨缺损模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: Large bone defects often lack an osteoinductive microenvironment, necessitating biomimetic scaffolds to enhance bone regeneration.
summary_en.method: A Zn-0.4Li porous scaffold with groove-ridge surface textures was fabricated via laser powder bed fusion by rationally designing the laser scanning strategy to control melt-track overlap.
summary_en.result: The scaffold promoted BMSC adhesion and spreading, activated mechanotransduction signaling, and enhanced osteogenic differentiation, accelerating new bone formation and osseointegration in a rabbit calvarial defect model.
summary_en.validation: Validation included in vitro cell assays and an in vivo rabbit critical-sized calvarial defect model.
